title: Which executes first: hashCode or equals
answer: In a typical HashMap lookup, hashCode() is evaluated first to identify a candidate bucket; equals() is only needed when candidate entries must be compared. Do not memorize that both always run; the collection first hashes, and equals() depends on whether matching bucket candidates exist.
